Name: Grilled bug steak
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hello y'all, It's me again, ritzygen, and I have made a very stupid mod instead of sleeping.

it allows you to cook bug steak by adding 3 cooking recipes + items.
you can buy the recipes at the Saloon, after reaching mining level 2.
they cost 150, 175, and 250g respectively.


[size=4]REQUIRES:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]﻿
INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS: [/size][size=3]Extract the .zip files into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[/size][size=2]I might add on to this mod later.


[/size][size=4]
